explanation: A₁(N) is the number of maximal Sidon subsets of [1,N] (IsMaximalSidonSetIn: Sidon, and no further element of [1,N] can be added), as on erdosproblems.com/862. Question: is A₁(N) < 2^{o(N^{1/2})}? The answer is no, via Saxton–Thomason (A₁(N) ≥ 2^{(0.16+o(1))√N}). The statement negates log₂ A₁(N) = o(√N), which is the negation of the question. Faithful.
